_: The ONE toolchain pin for the in-browser playground. The payload bakes the INSTALLED moon toolchain's core .mi/.core bundles (assemble.mjs) and hands them to a js_of_ocaml moonc built elsewhere (@moonbit/moonc-worker), so the two must come from the same moonc. Bump both fields together, re-fetch with `node playground/build/fetch-compiler.mjs --force`, and re-run `cmd/dev -- playground` (check-viewgen-tab.mjs is what proves the pair agrees).
